action_remarks: If temp <35C for >2 h continuously, DCS opens heating valve VLV-301.
If pH <6.5 at any time, DCS stops feed pump PMP-201 and raises Critical alarm "DGT-101 pH Low-Low".
If pressure >+15 mbar, vent valve VLV-803 opens for 30 s.
Identical response: VLV-302 opens if temp <35C for >2 h.
pH <6.5 stops PMP-202 and alarms Critical.
Same overpressure response as DGT-101 via VLV-804.
If level >95%, DCS starts flare FLR-601 and inhibits CHP gas supply. If level <20%, CHP supply inhibited and Warning alarm active.
Pressure relief valve VLV-802 set to lift at 55 mbar.
High-High alarm at 12.5 bar: DCS trips burner and initiates emergency shutdown (Critical).
If >150 ppm, DCS diverts biogas to flare and raises High H2S alarm.
If <850C, DCS inhibits waste gas feed and triggers alarm.
If >98C, DCS derates engine to 50% load.
If airflow <6 ACH, DCS issues Warning alarm.

condition: methane concentration (CH4) measured by the biogas analyser GAS-701 falls below 50% vol for a period exceeding 30 minutes
action: DCS shall stop the CHP-1001 engine and divert all biogas to the flare FLR-601

condition: digester level is above the minimum agitator immersion level (2.0 m from tank bottom)
High H2S alarm (H2S-901 outlet >150 ppm) is active
requirement: control room operator must acknowledge it within 5 minutes

condition: alarm is not acknowledged within 5 minutes
action: DCS automatically initiates flaring and sends a plant-wide alert notification

condition: alarms designated as "Critical" (including DGT-101/102 pH Low-Low, BLR-501 High-High Steam Pressure, GSH-401 Level High-High, and CH4 <40% vol)
requirement: must be acknowledged by the control room operator within 3 minutes of annunciation

action: escalates to the Shift Supervisor's pager and activates the facility siren

condition: RMS vibration of AGT-301, measured by sensor VIB-301, exceeds 7.1 mm/s for more than 15 minutes continuously
action: maintenance work order shall be auto-generated with priority "Urgent", to be addressed within 24 hours

condition: absolute difference between the two readings [TT-101A and TT-101B] exceeds 1.5C for more than 1 hour
action: both probes must be inspected and recalibrated within 48 hours

condition: zero drift exceeds 2% of full scale (full scale = 100% vol CH4) or the span drift exceeds 5% of the reading
action: DCS shall schedule a recalibration task due within 48 hours

condition: differential pressure across the H2S scrubber H2S-901 exceeds 25 mbar
action: DCS shall generate a maintenance request to replace the media

requirement: undergo a comprehensive inspection every 8,000 operating hours or 12 calendar months, whichever occurs first

action: DCS shall issue a "Boiler Service Due" reminder 30 days before the deadline

logging: test and result (success/failure) must be logged in the shift log by the maintenance technician

requirement: atmosphere must be tested for CH4 (<10% LEL), H2S (<10 ppm), and O2 (19.5-23.5%) within 15 minutes prior to entry
dedicated standby attendant with continuous radio contact shall be posted
entry supervisor must log the entry permit in the electronic system and obtain acknowledgment from the Shift Supervisor within 15 minutes of permit activation

condition: during entry, the CH4 concentration exceeds 5% LEL
action: all personnel must evacuate immediately and the evacuation alarm sounded

condition: flare FLR-601 is in operation (flame detected)
requirement: 15-metre radius exclusion zone is enforced. No personnel entry is permitted without explicit authorisation from the Shift Supervisor
